contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 6ème : Famille, environnement, actualité simple

questions.question: What is the English word for 'famille'?
'The environment is important to protect' is a True statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'environnement'?
'Recycling helps reduce waste and conserve natural resources' is a True statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'actualité'?
'Climate change is a significant global issue' is a True statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'simple'?
'The internet provides access to a wealth of information and resources' is a True statement.
